headline: Interface shutdown and archive configuration update
executive_summary: The device configuration was updated to include archive settings, and the GigabitEthernet2 interface was administratively shut down.
technical_summary: Added archive configuration and applied 'shutdown' to interface GigabitEthernet2. An invalid input error was logged.
risk_reason: Shutting down an active interface (GigabitEthernet2) that serves as an internal routing peer is a high-risk action that will disrupt network connectivity.
potential_impact: Likely loss of connectivity to R1 and potential routing instability.
recommended_action: Immediately review the necessity of shutting down the interface and restore it if it was unintentional.
rollback_recommendation: Rollback immediately if the interface shutdown was not part of a planned maintenance window.
